composite_card.title: Tail carry-state fold/replay co-design
composite_card.search_radius: The existing carry ancilla/reduction state between controlled_mod_add_k or controlled_mod_sub_vented and fused_double_cdouble/fused_double_cdouble_reverse at the four widened tail calls. It explicitly excludes k-table retuning, comparator windows, codec encoding/width, ITERS, SCHED_J2, traversal count, early-sum lifetime changes, and any global strip-table re-mine.
composite_card.mechanism: At each selected tail call, schedule k only selects a hybrid-adder layout; BZ-03 shows that choice does not make a live stream difference. Instead, represent the modular reduction carry as pending fold metadata already required by the next double/cdouble, consume it in the fold, and undo that representation at the matching inverse apply boundary. The candidate must delete a clean/carry pair or source-prove a downgrade. It is not permitted to merely move equal work, retain a new persistent register, add a tape symbol, or widen a cswap.

interfaces.interface: apply_step_forward -> controlled_mod_add_k -> fused_double_cdouble and reverse counterpart apply_step_reverse -> controlled_mod_sub_vented; the selected carry state is consumed in the same pass and restored in exact inverse order.
The 53-bit fold window and hybrid-add cout contract are unchanged; the carry representation must fit existing LSBS/chunk boundaries and may not change adder layout selection by scalar k.
Dialog tape stays 609 qubits and positional forward/reverse consumption stays identical. s2-controlled walk and replay retain their existing paired branches.
Deep-strip tuple/ordinal occupancy is an exact-stream input. Source-certified deletions may be attributed by site; all other changed ordinal keys are dropped or re-mined only after approval.

invariant_pairs.invariant: The forward pending-carry representation is reconstructed then consumed by the exact reverse counterpart, so the composed transform is identity on all non-output state and carries no residual phase.
invariant_pairs.proof: Algebraic reversible miter over the selected add/fold/unfold/sub region plus phase-word/ancilla selftest; four-check evaluation remains later required.

invariant_pairs.invariant: s2 conditionality, cswap order, and s=SCHED_J2[i]-cmp_window(i) are unchanged in both directions. The representation is selected only after the same existing control and cannot cross a one-sided branch.
invariant_pairs.proof: Per-call trace witness records pass, divstep, s2 control, carry source, fold consumer, and reverse restoration; mismatch or any new tape/predicate use falsifies.

invariant_pairs.invariant: After the widened fold, the next 256-bit cout input remains below 2^256 minus its maximal addend; no 257-bit cswap or extra live overflow bit is introduced.
invariant_pairs.proof: Symbolic bound with fixed LSBS=53 plus deterministic classical boundary corpus; a sampled corpus is discriminator evidence, not a replacement for the bound.

invariant_pairs.invariant: A source proof identifies every deleted/downgraded operation independently of ordinal. The final stream reports occupancy honestly; unproven stale statistical keys receive no credit.
invariant_pairs.proof: Source bit-use/affine or UNSAT certificate per claimed site, candidate tripwire log, and approved exact-stream re-mine only if remaining keys are needed for final T.

invariant_pairs.proof: TRACE_TLM_PROFILE and B0 windows at early apply, late walk, and square; artifact max referenced qubit id must remain 1153.
